sentences.en: The prime minister already voted in his city of residence.
sentences.zh: 总理已经在他的居住城市投了票。

sentences.en: You'll have to establish residence here before you can vote.
sentences.zh: 你必须在此地定居才能投票。

sentences.en: Yanukovych’s Mezhyhirya residence became a corruption museum of sorts.
sentences.zh: Yanukovych 的梅季希娅庄园成了某种意义上的腐败博物馆。
